title: migrate: text-family fields keep raw number/boolean and SQLite "N.0" rows written before #29241; driver-memory raw scalars are decidable, SQLite "N.0" text is not
body:
domain:server#2 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbXKRzgnVvjzxaYxLUf

立卡门类别: ① 产品缺陷 — 具名落点. Item 3 of #29643 ("say whether the text family (#29241) needs the same pass, and either fold it in or name its card"): not folded into PR #29700, so this is its card.
class: a · reach: `engine.insert` / REST create on a base before #29241 stored a text-family field written `42` as the raw `42` on driver-memory with persistence and as the TEXT `"42.0"` on SQLite. Measured on `origin/main` 7dae3b3c by writing rows below the door as the pre-#29241 door did (PR #29700 "Why" table, row "text field 42").
业务理由: since #29241 a new write stores `42` as `"42"`, but rows written before keep the old form. A filter on `"42"` misses them, a read hands back `42` or `"42.0"`, and on a unique text field a new `"42"` does not collide with an old `"42.0"`. Operators who wrote numbers or booleans into text fields (imports, API clients, flows) get two stored shapes for one value until a migration exists; #29241 accepted that posture only until then.
动手的读者: `domain:server` seat, the `os migrate` one-shot family (`os migrate option-codes` from #29643 / PR #29700 and `os migrate blank-single-values` are the siblings). Suggested-grade: p2 · same shape and cost as #29643, which triage graded p2.
查重: `is:issue migrate text number stored` → 324 hits, none a stored-row card for the text family; `29241 old rows` → 7, nearest #29643 (option family, this card's twin), #29486 (filter comparand on text fields, query side only), #29241 (closed, the write door).

## What is decidable

- A raw number or boolean on driver-memory with persistence is decidable by type: it becomes `String(value)`, the string the door stores since #29241.
- A SQLite `"42.0"` on a text field is **not** decidable: a text field has no declared codes, so `"42.0"` may be the old number or a string a client typed. #29643 reports the same form as `free-field` on an option field with no declared codes and never rewrites it.

## Wanted

1. Measure first on SQLite and driver-memory: write rows below the door as the pre-#29241 door did, then report what a read, a filter and a unique insert answer (PR #29700's measurement is the model).
2. Rewrite the decidable values (raw number/boolean → `String(value)`), and report the SQLite `"N.0"` text values per object and field, never rewritten. Dry run by default, as the family does. Whether this is an arm of `os migrate option-codes` or its own sibling is the dev's call; `os migrate value-shapes` stays read-only (#29431 ruling 6588116815).
3. Postgres and MySQL faces were not measured in PR #29700 (no server in that container); measure them if a container has one, otherwise say so in the report.

**Level:** a migration the operator runs; no write-door change. Expect `Clause-②: no`.
